variants.label: 12-night Maui + Kauai plan
variants.notes: Five Kihei nights, four Poipu nights and three Princeville/Hanalei nights; June 18 PTO depends on employer holiday observance.

alternateNotes: No shorter version is promoted: eleven nights loses the full-length scoring benefit and compresses either Maui recovery or Kauai's south/north split.
